p.src: 1  Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

ja: のようであったなら。 私の母の乳房を吸った兄弟のようであったなら。
づけする。 そうしても、誰も
en: Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.
u.src: 1  Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother! If I found you outside, I would kiss you; yes, and no one would despise me.

p.src: 2  I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

ja: く。 母は私を教えてくれるだろう。
は香料を混ぜたぶどう酒、 私のざくろの果
en: I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.
u.src: 2  I would lead you, bringing you into the house of my mother, who would instruct me. I would have you drink spiced wine, of the juice of my pomegranate.

p.src: 3  His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

en: His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.
u.src: 3  His left hand would be under my head. His right hand would embrace me.

p.src: 4  I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

ja: たちよ、あなたがたに誓わせる。
めさせたりしないでください。
en: I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.
u.src: 4  I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires.

zh: 8:4 不要叫醒......情願：或譯不要激動愛情，等它自發

p.src: 5  Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

ja: は誰か。 愛する人に寄りかかって。 愛する女 りんごの
ました。 そこで、あなたの
はあなたを身ごもり、 そこで
しみを味わい、あなたを産んだ。
en: Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.
u.src: 5  Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Beloved Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother conceived you. There she was in labor and bore you.

p.src: 6  Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.

ja: 章のように、 あなたの
く、 その熱情はよみ のように苛烈だ。 そのきらめきは
のきらめき、 まさに
en: Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
u.src: 6  Set me as a seal on your heart, as a seal on your arm; for love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol. Its flashes are flashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.

ja:
8:6 よみ（シェオル）は死者の場所である。
8:6 ヘブライ語では「יה」（ヤハ）である。
en:
8:6 Sheol is the place of the dead.
8:6 Hebrew: יה Yah

p.src: 7  Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

ja: しても、 たださげすまれるだけだ。
en: Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.
u.src: 7  Many waters can’t quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man would give all the wealth of his house for love, he would be utterly scorned.

p.src: 8  We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

en: We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?
u.src: 8  We have a little sister. She has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister in the day when she is to be spoken for?

p.src: 9  If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

en: If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.
u.src: 9  If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar.

p.src: 10  I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

en: I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.
u.src: 10  I am a wall, and my breasts like towers, then I was in his eyes like one who found peace.

p.src: 11  Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

ja: ソロモンはバアル・ハモンにぶどう畑を
し出した。 番人はそれぞれ、その
めることになっていた。
en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
u.src: 11  Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.

ja: 8:11 一シェケルは約10グラム、あるいは約0.35オンスである。千シェケルは約10キログラム、または約22ポンドである。
en: 8:11 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or about 22 pounds.

p.src: 12  My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

ja: のもの。 ソロモンよ、
シェケルはあなたに。 その
en: My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
u.src: 12  My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.

p.src: 13  You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

ja: けている。 あなたの声を
en: You who dwell in the gardens, with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice!

p.src: 14  Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!
